posts.title: The Winds of Change for the Palestine Cause Are Blowing Their Way
posts.seo_title: Winds of Change for the Palestine Cause | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: How Operation Al-Aqsa Flood reshaped the Palestine question overnight, and why Malaysians should pay close attention to what comes next.
posts.content: Hamas launched a sophisticated assault on Israel dubbed “Operation Al-Aqsa Flood,” capitalising on Israel’s redeployment of troops to the West Bank.

posts.title: DAP Wishes for the Demise of UMNO
posts.seo_title: DAP Wishes for the Demise of UMNO | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: UMNO sits in the coalition government but can no longer safeguard Malay rights. Suara Malaysia examines a party reduced to an ornamental vase.
posts.content: UMNO’s presence in the coalition government is incapable of safeguarding Malay rights; it merely serves as an ornamental vase.

posts.excerpt: An Asia360 News interview with Anwar Ibrahim on how a diverse upbringing shaped his worldview and an ambitious political career.
posts.content: Anwar Ibrahim’s diverse upbringing shapes his expansive worldview and ambitious political career.

posts.title: Chinese Chauvinism, Racist Eugenics and a Porn Star Wannabe
posts.seo_title: Chinese Chauvinism and Racist Eugenics in Malaysia | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: Chinese-based parties cry ‘racist’ at dissenters while voicing racial sentiments on single-stream education. A look at an unresolved national tension.
posts.content: The critique targets Chinese-based political parties and groups in Malaysia, accusing them of labelling dissenters as ‘racist’ or ‘anti-Chinese’, while expressing racial sentiments on issues like single stream education. This paradox reveals an unresolved national tension.
posts.featured_image_alt: Illustration accompanying the commentary on Chinese chauvinism in Malaysia

posts.title: 13th General Elections and a Free Media
posts.seo_title: GE13 and a Free Media in Malaysia | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: With Parliament dissolved for GE13, Suara Malaysia asks whether Barisan Nasional, Pakatan Rakyat and regional parties will fight fair in a free media.
posts.content: As every Malaysian would have known by now, the Prime Minister announced the dissolution of Parliament and hence paved the way for the nation’s thirteenth general elections. With that in mind, it is hoped that both the major political coalitions (Barisan Nasional and Pakatan Rakyat) as well as regional parties will engage their opponents in a fair contest of ideas.
posts.featured_image_alt: Electoral reforms poster ahead of Malaysia’s 13th general election

posts.title: Blackout Elections!
posts.seo_title: Blackout Elections: Standing with Malaysians after GE13 | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: In solidarity with Malaysians who wanted change after GE13 but were denied it by widespread fraud and gerrymandering.
posts.content: In solidarity with fellow Malaysians who wanted change after GE13 but were robbed of it due to widespread fraud and gerrymandering.
posts.featured_image_alt: Black square symbolising the post-GE13 blackout protest

posts.title: Neither Free nor Brave: A Response to Alvin Tan
posts.seo_title: Neither Free nor Brave: A Response to Alvin Tan | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: Academic prowess is no substitute for wisdom or courage. A response to Alvin Tan that honours the Malaysian youth working for a shared destiny.
posts.content: Criticism is levelled at perceived selfish cowardice and lack of wisdom, despite academic prowess. This overlooks the sacrifices of Malaysian youth committed to a shared destiny, a higher calling for national improvement.
posts.featured_image_alt: Crying baby illustration used for the response to Alvin Tan

posts.title: Monarchy at Our Nation’s Foundations
posts.seo_title: Monarchy at Our Nation’s Foundations | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: Like a palace built without nails, ruler and people in Malay history were inseparable. A historical perspective that challenges the ‘absolute feudal’ label.
posts.content: The concept of ‘monarchy as the nation’s foundations’ recalls a palace built without nails, emphasising the inseparable nature of rulers and people. It contests the common misconception that past Rajas’ rule was absolute, challenging oversimplified feudal labels.

posts.title: Asadullah Ali al-Andalusi
posts.seo_title: Asadullah Ali al-Andalusi: Muslim Apologetics and Atheism | Suara Malaysia
posts.excerpt: A profile of Asadullah Ali al-Andalusi, a leading voice in Muslim apologetics and comparative religion who examines atheism in Muslim communities.
posts.content: Asadullah Ali al-Andalusi is a prominent figure in Muslim apologetics and comparative religion, particularly focusing on Atheism, a rarely examined ideology in Muslim communities.
